Selling 3 goods ~16 alashi gross. Shuttle expected 2.25 goods, produce 2. Shuttle slightly better but risk. Also influence matters: I'm 2nd in rank? Rank by cash: 39.64, 29, 26.54 — I'm 2nd. Bribe to gain influence for 5% commission bonus and president. Bribe 5 to idx0 gives influence 2 — could tie idx1 (influence 2); president decided at law entry by influence then tie_order — I'd be behind. Bribe 10 gives influence 3, becomes president — but president holder 0 currently. Cost 10 alashi for influence 3 + presidency. Value: 5% of bank ~1.5 alashi commission + law control. Also vote_weight.

But cash is rank metric. Paying 10 drops me to 19, close to idx1's 26.5. Hmm, rank final determines 50/30/15 shares of bank. Bank=30M, payout ~28.5M: 14.25/8.55/4.275. Difference rank1 vs rank2 = 5.7 alashi. Bribe 10 would drop rank — bad unless gained later.

Produce: goods 2, sell next market at ~5-6 each → +11 alashi, securing rank. That seems best. Choose produce.
